# OverCue Desktop 2.2.70 for Windows

- **Save Live Stems to a USB:** the Live Stems page has a new **Stems on this computer** section. Plug in the USB a track came from and press **Save stems to USB**. Its stems are saved onto the USB just like stems made on the USB here: the same format and waveforms, with no stem louder than the full mix, so players load them from the USB without this computer.
- Set how much space the stems on this computer may use (up to 200 GB). Turn on **Remove stems from this computer after saving them to a USB** to free that space automatically. When saving finishes, the result stays on screen, and any track that could not be saved shows why.
- Live Stems now also works with other linked players that support OverCue stems, not just CDJ-3000s.
- Player cards on the Live Stems page no longer flicker between a track and No track.
